DECISION: reach-baseline-result-decision-20261023
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Accept the completed baseline as evidence for prioritizing planner command generation/selection. The overseer read the raw result.json:8selected/complete/start-accepted/comparison-claimed; zero differing repeats. Independently recomputed16of16 hands nearer with D at step5 and step60; smallest advantage0.50346cm and1.51795cm respectively. Primary both-hands arrival-and-hold: D bodies2and5, P none. This is useful physical capacity revealed by a better supplied command. It is not a trained planner improvement. Do not enable D as a general controller from this result, and do not release r2.

Next action, the builder owns and starts now: a bounded source/saved-record trace of why the actual planner produced P rather than a command like D. Initial investigation capped15minutes wall time, no simulator or training/model-loading run. Use the exact a2 checkout7dd0eabda and existing captures; no new inventory framework or report series.
1. Trace saved target to command construction, candidate seeds/constraints, ranking and final decoder input. Identify whether the direct-world-target candidate was offered at all. Show exact code lines and recorded values for one large miss (body5) and one other body, then check whether the same path covers all8.
2. If it was offered, identify the recorded score components/rejection reason and which command actually won. If not, identify the specific candidate-generation omission. Distinguish evidence actually recorded from a score reconstructed later. Missing candidate scores are a specific evidence gap, not proof of bad ranking.
3. Separate positional/orientation/strength transformations, wrong frames or targets, candidate exclusion, and predictor/ranking error. D changed multiple body rows; the comparison does not isolate one joint or prove a scalar score change is the cure. Preserve the step5 horizon when examining the forecast. Use saved command/joint/contact arrays to explain the remaining D miss in body0 or7 only if already available within this same bounded read.
4. Return one concise cause-and-repair proposal in the existing D1 record: exact failing path, proposed code change, why it should improve physical reaching, what could still fail, and the smallest measured comparison that would settle adoption. A confirmed local coding defect may be repaired on an isolated branch and independently reviewed within this preparation authority; no production adoption, training or new physical run until the concrete package decision. Do not launch r2 merely because it is ready. If time expires, return precise code/evidence found and the one missing item, not another broad task list.

Closeout work in existing files, without a new status document: update reach_baseline_20261023 and the planner register issues causal_body_prediction_calibration and s4_search_learning_comparison to link these results and the named next action, preserving history. Update the existing dashboard/plan status through its owner with plain wording: direct commands moved all16 hands closer; two of eight bodies reached and held both hands; planner command investigation next. Keep the2cm and first-arrival definitions accessible, and note body3's right hand started close. Do not treat a data-collectionPASS as a reachingPASS. No wholesale page rewrite.

Launcher defect: authorize narrow preparation repair of detached supervisor output-pipe inheritance before reuse, with hidden window and explicit stdout/stderr destinations. Preserve missing-start-record evidence; do not fabricate that record retrospectively. Obtain independent review and one small non-simulation child-process check proving prompt return, continuing child identity, preserved logs and completion receipt. This check is a separate launcher correctness question, capped60seconds total; no repeat physics, no full suite. Production run limits must remain enforced independently of the launching shell.

Keep result.json, records.npz and original learned states. For the1.4GB tmp copies, apply the existing lifecycle process: provide exact paths and original/hash equivalence before source-copy deletion; this message is not blanket deletion authority. Installer-recreation log attribution remains assigned, bounded/read-only; it must not postpone the planner trace. No machine-setting change.

No further simulator or training launch authorized. Return one consolidated cause/repair report with actual investigation time and launcher status, not acknowledgement-only updates.
